text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A in stages at large gains felt satisfying, but future sales should follow my investment plan rather than the urge to lock in a win.","I held through several strong months and then a sharp decline; I should review each holding’s outlook and risk periodically instead of relying on past gains or reacting to one month.","My infrequent trading helps me avoid impulsive decisions, but I should still check diversification and keep loss aversion from preventing sensible portfolio changes."]}
